event: A scraping sound comes up, and the robot needs to determine the relative direction of the sounding object.

sounding_object.description: A metallic cooking pan, dark-colored (possibly non-stick coated), appearing to be a frying pan or saucepan, approximately 10-12 inches (25-30 cm) in diameter. The scraping sound is produced when this pan is being washed/scrubbed in the kitchen island sink by a person.

reference_object.description: A large, rectangular wooden dining table with a light-colored, smooth top (possibly maple or similar light wood). It is approximately 2 meters long and 1 meter wide, positioned in the main dining/living area.

facing_object.description: A rectangular wooden coffee table, appearing to be made of a darker wood than the dining table. It has a low, simple design and is located in the living room area, in front of a sofa. It is approximately 1.2 meters long and 0.6 meters wide.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the rectangular dining table and facing the rectangular wooden coffee table, when the scraping sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
